about: Generated by tools/map_layout.mjs from map/world/S4b.json; never edit. Metres in the section frame: X east (out of the city in S5), D north, H up. Entities keep their map IDs; figures and trees also carry their slug as id for people.json.

assumptions: East-west and height 77 px per metre, depth 51.25 px of v per metre, as every section (S5). Things far up the silk are painted smaller (questions: the diminution); positions only come from the map (BUILDING.md rule 5).

dx = 31.6 px per metre north everywhere in S4b (the seam knot, constant). It is not a measurement here: the painter draws each group of furniture from its own side (questions). With it, a north-south edge of the shop hall's or the tea house's furniture maps 49-52 degrees west of north, and one of the bottom shop's 40 degrees east of north; builders orient furniture by their own choice (choice:), and only base points are placed from the map.
Painted figure size is not a scale (street figures 150-176 px on the road, 1.9-2.3 m at 77 px/m). Place by foot point.
The bank top on both sides of the river and the far bank are at street level (supports `bank top`, `far bank`).

datum.about: where the main road crosses the seam with S4 part 1 (u 12600): S4b.road.main's centre-line point 0, exactly scan (12600, 1206), S4's centre line there (between part 1's (12500, 1200) and (12750, 1215)). Station +67.95 there, S4's station at that point, so stations run on.

trees.what: Big old bare willow with a massive, gnarled, knotted trunk rising from behind the south row's roofs by the road and forking: the east leader climbs north-east past the biggest moored boat's bow, its branches crossing in front of the boat's deck house; the west leader leans north-west to a knot at about (15350, 1070), from which a long, nearly level limb runs west over the road to the tea house's east end and droops there to about v 1110; long fine whips fan out west and up from the crown (u 15230-15450) and hang down between the leaders. No leaves.
Faint bare tree on the river's far (north) bank at the top of the silk, north of the top boat's cabin: a thick trunk leaning north-east with branches spreading east along the top edge.

Young bare tree with upright, budding twigs (not willow whips) rising from the gap between two south-row roofs at the road's south edge; its slender stem leans and arches north-east into the old willow's crown.
Faint bare tree on the river's far (north) bank at the very top of the silk, north of the top boat: a short trunk of two stems with a few branches, cut off by the silk's top edge.

A short, thick, gnarled trunk outlined in moss dots stands at the edge of the bank just west of the moored boats' bank ends, rising and hooking over to the east with a dark knob at its top: an old stump or a small bent tree, bare.
Willow whose bare whips spring from a knob above the gate behind the tea house and fan out in a round, unleafed crown over the riverside ground; trunk unseen. Bare, early spring.
Willow whose bare whips fan upward above the dark crown of the big gnarled tree, between the top-of-silk shops; its head and trunk are hidden behind the big tree. Bare, early spring.
Willow whose fine bare whips radiate upward from a knob above the big two-stemmed elm's fork, fanning over the big roof behind the trees; its trunk is unseen. Bare, early spring.

Big bare deciduous tree (elm-like: gnarled bark with knot holes, crooked twigs tipped with buds, no leaves) whose thick trunk stands at the west end of the tea house and forks low into two stems: the west stem leans far north-west over the wheelwright's shed to the top street, its crown spreading over the pack mules; the east stem rises over the big roof east of the shed.

Big old bare tree whose leaning, knotted trunk rises from the back of the crowd between the tall man and the bearded man and forks at about v 280: a west limb with dark twig clumps and an east limb that spreads a wide fan of fine bare branches over the top-street stall to the edge of the silk; one trunk.

Old bare tree with a thick, knotted dark trunk and crooked branches hung with dark clumps of twigs (elm-like, no leaves), rising behind the big sloping roof and spreading over the shed roof at the head of the crowd; one trunk.
Tall straight bare tree, elm-like, the eastern of the pair, its trunk rising straight to the top of the silk with clusters of dark dotted buds or leaves on its upper branches.

Tall straight bare tree, elm-like, rising behind the big sloping roof to the top of the silk, its thin branches ending in clusters of dark dotted buds or leaves; one of a pair of straight trunks standing close together.

S4b.veh.boat_small_cabin_15182.name: small cabin boat by the far bank
S4b.veh.boat_small_cabin_15182.what: A smaller boat moored along the river's far bank at the top of the silk, lying east-west: an up-swept pointed west end with a small post or flag on it (15208-15218, 75-83), a low mat canopy over its west half, a higher mat-roofed cabin at its east end (u 15330-15460, v 62-90) with an opening in its end wall, and a short stick projecting east at deck level (u 15460-15487, v 83-90; a tiller?). No mast, no crew.

S4b.veh.boat_round_mat_15025.name: round-sterned boat with a barrel mat roof
S4b.veh.boat_round_mat_15025.what: A broad boat moored at the top of the group, seen almost end-on: its pointed bow with a forked post touches the landing at the top-left (forked post top (15012, 168)), its broad stern faces the viewer and the river to the south-east: a squared transom with an arched opening and a rudder stock (u 15155-15175, v 255-295) between bulging hull sides (u 15017-15252), a big arched mat roof over the hull (u 15045-15200, v 160-230); two poles lie over the bow, from (14965, 175) to (15015, 222) and at (14990-15020, 235-255). Its stern rests over the middle of S4b.veh.boat_long_cabin_14850.

S4b.veh.boat_arched_awning_14945.name: boat with an arched mat awning
S4b.veh.boat_arched_awning_14945.what: A boat moored between the mat-cargo boat and the big cabin boat, its west end hidden behind the big boat's roof cabin: an arched mat awning on hoops over its after half (u 15105-15407, v 459-560), a boatman seated under the awning's east end, a dark upturned head at the east end, a vertical stock (rudder?) and a pole slanting into the water below him; a rope from the east end runs east-south-east into the open water and ends with a small splash mark at (15592, 584) (an anchor line, past the seam). Rafted between S4b.veh.boat_mat_cargo_14900 (north) and S4b.veh.boat_big_cabin_14928 (south).

S4b.veh.boat_big_cabin_14928.name: big cabin boat (the biggest moored boat)
S4b.veh.boat_big_cabin_14928.what: The biggest boat of the moorings, the southernmost of five moored side by side with their west ends to the bank: a long timber hull with planked strakes and nail rows; at the west (bank) end a raked end under a hip-roofed cabin with a man seated on its roof; a long cabin with planked walls and posts along the middle, round woven baskets or bales on deck (u 15190-15360, v 600-700), a mat-roofed after cabin with railings (u 15500-15805) and a long tapering sweep blade trailing east in the water beyond the stern (u 15680-15855). A long spar lies along the cabin tops (v 625-640) from u ~15150 to a brush-like end at u ~15865: probably the lowered mast (a short post at u ~15340, v 575-620 may be its tabernacle; conf low). Two ropes run from the west end to S4b.prop.mooring_post_14737; a long pole lies from the post's foot along the hull's south side to about (15200, 765); another pole leans through a rope loop on the south side at (15440, 820) with its lower end in the water at (15343, 880). Rafted to S4b.veh.boat_arched_awning_14945 on its north side.

S4b.veh.boat_mat_cargo_14900.name: boat with mat-covered cargo
S4b.veh.boat_mat_cargo_14900.what: A long boat moored with its west end near the bank: a dark barrel-shaped mat roof over its west end (u 14905-15020, v 400-470), a deck loaded with woven mats or matted bales along the middle (u 15020-15275), a row of round coils or flat baskets on its deck at u 15040-15160 v 420-460, and a long tapering hatched spar projecting east at deck level to a point at (15390, 458) (a raised sweep, or a pointed bow board). A gangplank (a straight board about 4 px wide) runs from the bank path at (14760, 402), where t4's porter with two baskets stands, down to its west end at (14895, 463). A rope with small loops runs from about (15335, 468) east into the water, ending at (15507, 511) (an anchor line). Rafted between S4b.veh.boat_long_cabin_14850 (north) and S4b.veh.boat_arched_awning_14945 (south).

S4b.veh.boat_long_cabin_14850.name: long boat with a deckhouse
S4b.veh.boat_long_cabin_14850.what: A long boat moored with its high west end at the bank under a big dark mat roof (u 14845-15020, v 245-320), a planked deck cabin with a round emblem in the middle (u 15030-15200), and a deckhouse with lattice windows and a hipped roof at its east end (roof eave to (15391, 371), end wall at u 15355, v 373-410); two boatmen stand on its south deck at u 15040-15070. Rafted between S4b.veh.boat_round_mat_15025 (north, whose stern rests over its middle) and S4b.veh.boat_mat_cargo_14900 (south).

S4b.veh.palm_cart_13455.name: second palm-covered family cart (大棕盖车)
S4b.veh.palm_cart_13455.what: Big two-wheeled family cart under a great shaggy roof of palm thatch with a ridge knob, heading north-east: a light ox in the shafts and a lead ox on traces ahead of it; a big spoked wheel under its middle; a dark sack or bundle slung under the bed's rear half; a bare-headed driver walks beyond the shaft ox and a carter beside its hindquarters, while a porter at the rear reaches up to the bed.

S4b.veh.sedan_chair_13140.name: dark-roofed sedan chair set down beside the first cart
S4b.veh.sedan_chair_13140.what: Tall sedan chair (轿) set down on its short corner legs on the road just east of the first palm-covered cart: a panelled box with a lattice window high in its south side and a narrow door strip at its west end, under a dark domed roof with up-turned eaves; its carrying poles run east at about mid-height toward a man standing by it (t2's figure, likely its bearer).

S4b.veh.palm_cart_13070.name: first palm-covered family cart (parked, no team)
S4b.veh.palm_cart_13070.what: Big palm-covered family cart (大棕盖车) parked on the north side of the road in front of the official hall: a huge shaggy roof of palm fibre over a tall box body, a black cord along the roof's ridge that loops down near each end, a lattice-railed under-frame and one big spoked wheel (the near, south one) showing above the south roof. At its east end a short frame juts out and ends in a carved beam end (the roots of the shafts, read as its front); no shafts, yoke or animals are drawn, so it stands unhitched. A small figure stands at its west end and a person sits under the thatch at its front.

S4b.veh.boat_arched_awning_14945.why: the moorings at real size (BUILDING.md 'Boats and water'): shortened to 0.6 of its type (12 m against its painted 6.1 m, west half hidden) its hull, centred on the painted midpoint, ran 0.9 m onto the bank at its bow and 0.3 m into the big cabin boat; moved outward (east, over open water) 1.6 m until its raked bow's top (1.5 m past the stem) no longer lies over the bank top (the shore walls stood across its foredeck: QA), and 0.15 m north to clear the big boat (0.36 m)

S4b.veh.boat_mat_cargo_14900.why: rafted between the arched-awning boat and the long boat, whose painted centre lines are 1.8 m from it, under any real beam: at 0.6 of its type (12 x 3.1 m) it moves 2.1 m north to clear the arched boat (0.24 m gap); outward (east) 1.35 m so its stem reaches the shore, and 2.4 m more so that its painted gangplank has a gap to span (the bow's raked top otherwise lies over the bank path and the plank could not run from the bank down to its deck, as painted)

S4b.veh.boat_long_cabin_14850.why: next north in the raft: at 0.6 of its type (11.4 x 3.0 m) it moves 4.35 m north to clear the mat-cargo boat (0.39 m gap) and 5.6 m east (outward), so its raked bow clears the cove's north-west bank and the top house's east wall (at 4.05 m its bow lay 1.3 m over the bank top and against the wall: QA); the room comes from the far bank moved north (how: S4b.water.bian_river)

S4b.veh.boat_round_mat_15025.why: the top of the raft, its stern painted over the long boat's middle (behind it, north): built as a small awning boat 5 m long (choice, boats) at its painted heading 148, moved north with the raft 5.7 m to clear the long boat (0.15 m) and 0.9 m east to keep its bow at the cove's (moved) north-west shore, the painted landing

S4b.veh.boat_small_cabin_15182.why: the small boat along the far bank: moved north with the far bank (how: S4b.water.bian_river) and 4.5 m east (downstream along the far bank, outward over open water) so it doesn't share its band of water with the round boat's diagonal hull (0.19 m apart)

S4b.fig.boatman_light_hat_15066.why: crew: goes with his boat (S4b.veh.boat_long_cabin_14850, dX 5.6) and 0.45 m further aft along its south deck: painted 0.22 m from the boatman in the dark cap, the two figures would stand inside each other at real size

S4b.bld.far_shed_15098.why: the far bank moved 5.5 m north along the frame's receding direction (how: S4b.water.bian_river): the shed on it goes with it

S4b.tree.far_bank_15308.why: on the far bank, moved with it (how: S4b.water.bian_river)

S4b.tree.far_bank_15230.why: on the far bank, moved with it (how: S4b.water.bian_river)

S4b.prop.table_14722.why: the customer in the dark cap is painted leaning on it, seated on his stool (stool_14840) 1.8 m east of its mapped centre: at real size (0.9 m long) its end stood 1.3 m short of his hands; moved east to his stool

S4b.prop.table_12645.why: the child's table (S4.fig.child_at_table_12597 of part 1 reaches onto its west end), painted inside the open east side of part 1's south hall (S4.bld.south_hall_12350): it stands on that hall's floor boards (H 0.23; builder: S4_HALL_FLOOR), not on S4b's ground 0.33 m under them, and at its painted place its top ran through the hall's east column (outer_road_scene.py: X 58.4, D -2.47, its base 0.36 m across); moved 0.27 m south-west so it clears the column (0.06 m) and its west end lies on the seam, where the top is painted (u 12599); the child steps with it (fix-s4b, details pass 2026-10-13: gen/details/contacts/fix_s4b/notes.md)

S4b.prop.chair_14458.why: the tea house's front furniture at real size stood half off its platform: the platform's front face is mapped (S4b.str.tea_house_platform_14520 edge, D 7.13-7.35 here) and the furniture's painted feet lie on it: the chair (0.44 m square) moved 0.25 m north (inward) so all four legs stand on the platform, and its sitter, the customer in the dark hat, with it (he stood on the ground at the platform's edge, 0.16 m under its floor; fix-s4b, details pass 2026-10-13)

S4b.prop.table_14518.why: the tea house's front furniture at real size stood half off its platform: the platform's front face is mapped (S4b.str.tea_house_platform_14520 edge, D 7.13-7.35 here) and the furniture's painted feet lie on it: the tea table (0.75 x 0.6 m) moved 0.2 m north (inward) with the two customers' seats either side of it (fix-s4b, details pass 2026-10-13)

S4b.prop.stool_14595.why: the tea house's front furniture at real size stood half off its platform: the platform's front face is mapped (S4b.str.tea_house_platform_14520 edge, D 7.13-7.35 here) and the furniture's painted feet lie on it: the stout man's stool moved 0.15 m north (inward) so it stands on the platform (fix-s4b, details pass 2026-10-13)
